captured.goal: Confirm this lead is identifiable and traceable, then fill capture context.

routed.goal: Assign the lead to an owner or operations queue.

engaging.goal: Track private-domain engagement and determine handoff readiness.
engaging.requirements: Effective touch, conversation, or operations activity should exist.
engaging.result: After confirmation, the lead moves to handoff-ready.

qualified_for_handoff.requirements: Handoff reason and key context should be available.
qualified_for_handoff.result: After submission, the lead moves to handoff pending.

handoff_pending.requirements: Handoff request has been submitted; do not repeat enrichment here.
handoff_pending.result: After downstream acceptance, the lead moves to accepted. Failure moves it to handoff failed.

existingFlow.title: Authorized company connection flow
existingFlow.verify: Retrieve credentials and verify the company application
existingFlow.assign: Select an owner and confirm connection
existingFlow.companyHint: Notifications for authorized companies appear here. If processing failed, reprocess the existing notification without scanning or resetting the Secret again.

openworkAuthorization.intro: Authorize a new company by scanning, or connect an authorized company after the server retrieves its credentials.
openworkAuthorization.existingHint: For applications installed in WeCom but not connected locally. The server retrieves and verifies credentials; you confirm the company and owner without entering a Secret.

staffTags.title: Employee tags

customerWorkspace.title: Customers
customerWorkspace.subtitle: Browse saved WeCom customers and update from WeCom when needed. Customers are independent of leads.
